abstract: This review of empirical evidence examines AI's impact on productivity and labor markets, finding small but statistically significant positive wage effects across AI-exposed occupations. As of December 2025, approximately 36% of US workers reported using generative AI, indicating substantial workforce adoption of these technologies.
keyFindings: Small but statistically significant positive wage effects were found across AI-exposed occupations
35.9% of US workers used generative AI by December 2025
methodology: Literature review of empirical evidence on AI's impact on productivity and labor markets. Specific data sources, sample sizes, and analytical methods not specified in excerpt.
qualifiers: Limited excerpt available; full methodology and scope of review not detailed in provided text. Findings characterized as 'small' wage effects despite statistical significance.
